pages.text: “Sweet aftertaste, soothing and hydrating, cleansing the body's impurities.”$(br2)Licorice Soup is a gentle and nourishing medicinal broth made from dried licorice and sugar. The amber-colored tea has a naturally sweet taste. Drinking it provides health regeneration and removes poison effects, helping travelers recover their vitality.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Licorice Soup, $(br)boil two portions of dried licorice with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed when suffering from poison, aiding travelers in restoring their health.

Upon drinking Licorice Soup, travelers gain a health regeneration effect and have poison effects removed, restoring their body to a normal state.$(br)This medicinal soup is ideal for detoxification and recovery.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
